My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
• Just now
I'm sorry to hear that your order arrived damaged. Here's what you should do:
Document the damage:
Take photos of the damaged packaging itself
Take clear photos of the entire product and close-ups of the affected areas
Include a common object near the damage to show scale
If the item has a law tag with a barcode, photograph both the front and back
Contact our support team:
Email the photos and a description of the damage to support@avocadomattress.com along with your order details, email, and current shipping address. Our team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps.
Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days, not including any production time needed to make the replacement item.
If your item arrived damaged, please reach out within 3 days of delivery to arrange a repair, replacement, or return. Items damaged due to manufacturing defects are eligible for a full refund or replacement under our warranty.
